comment: mitcad#1656: the plane_geometry answers of two sketches over bodies of many kinds (a filleted box, two joined cylinders whose crossing edges are splines, a sphere, a torus below the first sketch's plane, and a component turned about X with one body below the plane and one through it), as the listing before mitcad#1656 gave them: the enclosing boxes and edges by index must give the same. Sketch1 (F10) on the box's top, Sketch2 (F11) on XZ through every root body. The spline where the two cylinders cross is compared by where it runs (mitcad#1669): its ends, points of the true intersection (the circle of the upright cylinder seen from above; the crossing of both cylinders seen from the front) and its length, within 1e-6 mm. Its control points, knots, path and height come from the kernel's approximation and differ by platform, so they are not pinned.
